notes.title: Full Release Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey All!

[b]It's OFFICIAL.[/b]
We're leaving early access and doing a full release on [b]TUESDAY, AUGUST 28th, 2018[/b].


[u]Here's what you can expect:[/u] 

[list]

[*]Vive Support (FINALLY)

[*]Global Leaderboards: Make it to the top 5 to have your name visible to all in the office!

[*]Achievements: We've got 31 sweet achievements for you!

[*]More Polish: The game is visually more polished both in the office and store, and the ramping is tweaked.

[*]More donuts!

[*]A couple more items you can return.

[/list]

Thanks for all the support! We've decided to not add more levels/environments at this time, as we want to focus on a new project.

Please let us know your critiques, bug finds, comments and compliments in the discussions! And leave us a review!


Talk to you all soon, 
Karen & Cole <3

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28065543/07489f2fc81c281e4cd8fc755e73c1dd38e1b07b.png[/img]

notes.title: Oculus Touch Update!
notes.content:
Hello!

This is Karen and Cole with another update (yaaay!)

We've just released the latest version of Mister Mart! This update includes support for the Oculus Touch!

Now when you launch the game, there are two launch options: 

[list]
[*][b]Mister Mart: Oculus + Leap Motion Controller[/b]
This version of the game remains the same and untouched. 

[*][b]Mister Mart: Oculus + Oculus Touch Controllers[/b]
This version has full support for the Oculus and Oculus touch controllers. In addition, we've added angry customers that cause varying amounts of stress. 
[/list]

We hope those of you who have Oculus Touch controllers enjoy this version of Mister Mart. We find the Oculus Touch version satisfying to play and are excited to add more content to the game.
And to those who are waiting for the HTC Vive release, that is next on our list! :)


Also, Happy Summer Sale! We hope that this update is a little treat to celebrate. This is definitely a good time to purchase the game and join us on this journey! As a reminder, we plan to raise the price of the game in the future, as we have more updates released. 

That all being said, thank you for catching up with us! And thank you to everyone who visited our booth at Awesome Con! We now hope to see you at Gamescape(link below) in July! Feel free to leave feedback about the game in the discussions!


Love, 

Karen & Cole

PS - Link to Gamescape: http://www.artscape.org/visual-arts/visual-arts-detail/54

notes.title: Controllers?!?!?!!?!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] 

This is Karen, one half of Studio217, with an update!

It's been a couple months since our Early Access release, and we just wanted to say THANK YOU to all of you who are following our game and to those of you who purchased. <3

I know we've been pretty quiet and some of you have been asking for info, so we decided it was time for an announcement update!


[h1]Here's what's goin on:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Since the release, we've been working hard on getting either a Oculus Touch or Vive (w/ controllers) version(s) out. We've run into a lot of technical/updating issues, and are figuring these out as I speak. 

[*]With the addition of controllers, we're taking another look at the mechanical design of this grocery store level. We're hoping these design changes make the game more comfortable, and well-rounded for various playstyles. 

[*]As we make these updates, we're preparing to show at Awesomecon alongside MIVS(Magfest Indie Videogame Showcase) in Washington D.C. from June 16-18. If you're going to Awesomecon, come check us out! We'll have the latest Mart build there.

[*]We also want to note that we haven't forgotten about Leap Motion! Look for a Vive + Leap version in the future. The current plan is to release a controller version first then release an updated Leap version.

[*]Also in the next update, happy customers AND mad customers. (See screenshot below)
[/list]


That's the update for now! Feel free to leave questions/comments/critiques about the game in the discussions.


Love, 

Karen and Cole

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28065543/bc4e32a4d1543280c5f00ca426f84c4304e3846b.jpg[/img]
